name: apeDiscount
description: apeDiscount schema from Lightspeed Restaurant K Series API

name.description: The discount name as configured in merchant account.

code.description: The discount code as configured in merchant account.

discountPercentage.description: The discount percentage, may be fractional. A discount can be a percentage or an amount, but not both.

discountAmount.description: The discount amount, may be fractional. A discount can be a percentage or an amount, but not both.
